Scientists face an exponentially growing literature base that makes comprehensive searches impractical. Finding the information scientists need, frequently on niche and complex topics, takes days or weeks of effort and often requires consulting with an external expert in a narrow field.

To address this, GSK scientists use Undermind like an AI expert colleague or librarian assistant – they outline a problem statement or frontier topic, then the AI carefully assesses vast quantities of scientific literature and reports back its findings,
Additionally, Undermind continues to monitor the web for new research and proactively alerts users to anything new that comes out related to their topics of interest.
